rationale: Evaluator feedback highlighted that the previous candidate's base_speed of 0.9 was likely too high, contributing to instability, and that sensor_weights were symmetric and relatively large in magnitude, potentially causing overcorrection and oscillations. To address this, I reduced base_speed to 0.8 to improve stability on complex track sections. I adjusted sensor_weights to [-0.5, 0.6, -0.5], lowering the magnitude of the outer sensors and slightly reducing the middle sensor weight to soften corrections and reduce oscillations. Additionally, I changed the line_loss strategy from 'last_direction' to 'search_left' to test an alternative recovery method that might improve line recovery effectiveness. Geometry remains unchanged as it was not indicated to be problematic. I expect these changes to reduce steering oscillations, improve line tracking stability, and enhance recovery from line loss events. The requested measurements remain comprehensive to verify these hypotheses in the next telemetry.
